about: A sigil classifies a leading-segment positional by prefix, strips that prefix from its value, and leaves the ordinary positional cursor untouched.

vectors.doc: Several classified values may surround flags before the first ordinary positional.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
flag "--quiet"
arg "[tools]..." sigil="+"
arg "<command>"
arg "[args]..."

vectors.doc: Overlapping sigils select the longest matching declaration.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
arg "[short]..." sigil="+"
arg "[long]..." sigil="++"
arg "<command>"

vectors.doc: After an explicit separator the same prefix is ordinary data.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
arg "[tools]..." sigil="+"
arg "<command>"
arg "[args]..."

vectors.doc: A prefix with no value is not a classified argument.
A detached flag value owns the next token before sigil classification runs.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
flag "--label <label>"
arg "[tools]..." sigil="+"
arg "<command>"

vectors.doc: A classified positional before a known subcommand does not make the subcommand an ordinary value.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
arg "[tools]..." sigil="+"
cmd "build" { arg "<target>" }

vectors.doc: Once an automatic trailing positional starts, later sigil-shaped words are data.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
arg "[tools]..." sigil="+"
arg "<command>" double_dash="automatic"
arg "[args]..."
